class_id: rollout-flag zeroed silently voids live logic
symptom: a flag that gates a live code path (e.g. `CONSOLIDATION_PERCENTAGE`) sits at 0 (or a `PROD-REQUIRED-TRUE` boolean sits at `false`) in the prod env file — the guard/feature is present, tested and merged, but the value silently turns it off in production with no signal (T-282: `CONSOLIDATION_PERCENTAGE=0` voided the entire consolidation pipeline for an unknown period; presence-only checks like `assert-env-keys.sh`'s `SCRAPER_REQUIRED_KEYS` never caught it)
first_seen: T-282 (root cause); filed as discovery gap by T-297 D9 (issue #193)
fix_prs: this PR (`assert_rollout_flags_live()` in `scripts/assert-env-keys.sh`, reading `// LIVE-GATE` / `// PROD-REQUIRED-TRUE` markers straight off `scraper/src/config/feature-flags.ts` — no hand-duplicated flag list; prod slot only; `ALLOW_ZERO_FLAGS` escape hatch for a deliberate ramp-down)
detection_check: not one of the three sanctioned check types (no `SUBSTANCE_CHECKS` key, no `audit-detection-floor.mjs` `record()` id, no `audit-ipo-coverage.mjs` invariant) — this is a deploy-time config gate, not a DB-row audit check; guarded by `scripts/tests/assert-env-keys.test.sh`'s rollout-liveness cases (mutation-proof: reverting `assert_rollout_flags_live()` fails the suite, per the T-285 P3-1 lesson); registered in `docs/reviews/detection-checks.json` under `notCoveredByThisManifest` (deploy-time, not the nightly DB audit)
